summary: Iteration 15 - Dark Mode Implementation Testing. All dark mode features tested and working correctly. Theme toggle button (data-testid='theme-toggle-btn') present and functional on all pages: HomePage, LoginPage, RegisterPage, CustomerDashboard, SupplierDashboard. Dark mode persists in localStorage ('craftbolt-theme'). CSS overrides in App.css apply correctly with !important rules. Pricing section (199/299/399 Kč) readable in both themes with proper contrast.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode implementation fully tested and working. Key findings: 1) ThemeContext.js stores theme in localStorage as 'craftbolt-theme' (values: 'dark' or 'light'). 2) ThemeToggle component uses Moon/Sun icons from @phosphor-icons/react with data-testid='theme-toggle-btn'. 3) App.css contains global dark mode overrides using html.dark selector with !important rules. 4) tailwind.config.js has darkMode: ['class'] configured. 5) Theme toggle present in: HomePage header, LoginPage header, RegisterPage header, CustomerDashboard sidebar, SupplierDashboard sidebar, DemandDetail header, ProfilePage header. 6) Dark mode body background is #111827 (rgb(17, 24, 39)). 7) Input fields in dark mode have background #1f2937 (rgb(31, 41, 55)). 8) Price text in dark mode is rgb(249, 250, 251) providing good contrast. 9) Map tiles have CSS filter applied in dark mode for better contrast.
